title: Number line ١ to ٢٠ and dictation sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 2 (Number line ١ to ٢٠ and dictation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 2: Numbers 1 to 20 and my age. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: My age
points: كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ (kam 'umruka?) how old are you?
عُمْرِي اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً: I am twelve
عُمْرِي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً: I am thirteen

blocks.text: Write the Arabic word for each number under its digit.

box.title: Write the numbers your teacher says, in Arabic digits

questions.q: Write twenty in Arabic digits and words.
Core: Dictation of numbers: write the digits and words for 11, 13, 15, 18 and 20.
questions.a: ١١ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ؛ ١٣ ثَلَاثَةَ عَشَرَ؛ ١٥ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ؛ ١٨ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ؛ ٢٠ عِشْرُونَ

questions.q: Extend: Solve and write in Arabic words: ١٠ + ٦ = ? and ٢٠ − ٨ = ?
Stretch: Write a short profile: name, age, where you live: اِسْمِي ... عُمْرِي ... أَسْكُنُ فِي ...
questions.a: For example: اِسْمِي سَارَةُ. عُمْرِي اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً. أَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ.
A) سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ. ١٧ is seven-ten: سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ.

questions.q: What is عِشْرُونَ? A) 12 B) 20 C) 10
Big question: how does Arabic build 11 to 19?
questions.a: The unit number plus عَشَرَ (ten), e.g. خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ = 15; 11 and 12 have special forms.
